newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs can push on, 130.75 beckons.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs can push on, 130.75 beckons.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE have the potential to push towards the 130.75 peak on Thursday, bolstered by solid support stretching back to early April, technical analysts said.
"It's now moving into the top area of the January to March trading area," Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis, said.
"It looks as if it could push up and have a challenge of that top area, with sufficient support beneath it," she said.
BTPs were quoted at 130.36 at 0841 GMT, down three basis points on the day.
Analysts said the next main upside objective would be the 130.75 high hit on February 25. Beyond there, the contract high at 131.76 hit on January 23, was not too far off.
"To break the uptrend consistency it would have to move down now aggressively below 129.50 and break these series of rising lows that we've seen coming through since the end of March," Rigg added.
"We are going to have to break below the April rally peak at 129.00 to say this is a failed upward break area," she said.
BTPs hit a 129.50 low on Wednesday and cruised through the 129.00 area on May 7.

A technical analyst at an Italian Bank in London said Wednesday's price action was positive but this session's high at 130.54, equivalent to Wednesday's high would prove a difficult double top to overcome this session.
The up trendline was extremely steep and the contract was edging into overbought territory so a slowdown was likely, he said.
"If we break 130.21 it could trigger 30 ticks to the downside," he added.
At the short end, June Eurolire was quoted at 93.31, down 0.02 in the session.
